text:
maya: Starting deploy for rev-2026.03.21 (build 8f3a). Change window open — I'll kick off the deploybot and watch SLO dashboards. Links: https://dash.redwood/slo/embeddings | https://dash.redwood/slo/latency

deploy-bot: Deploy started -> prod. Canary policy: 5% for 15m, health checks on p95/p50/5xx. Notifying watchers. :rocket:

jake: Seeing p95 latency on /v1/embeddings jump to ~780ms (baseline ~220ms). 5xx rate on canary up from 0.8% -> 2.6%. Screenshot: https://logs.redwood/capture/abc123

sophia: I can reproduce a 429 spike on the prefix-cache shard. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x around the canary shift.

sam: recommend we pause the traffic shift and pin the canary at 5% while we triage. If behaviour persists, plan for rollback to v1.9.3.

maya: pausing traffic shift now. Running command:
```
/deploybot pause-shift --reason "observability-drift" --thread 1785559993
```

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused. Canary pinned at 5%. Alerts sent to oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20260321-27. Paging @oncall rotation. Runbook linked: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/deploy-drifts

jake: Quick diff between rev-2026.03.21 and v1.9.3: model runtime selected fallback kernel on some hosts -> increased GC frequency. Logs: `kernel_fallback=true, gc_pause_ms=45` in multiple hosts. I can temporarily route 20% away from canary to confirm if it's model runtime related.

sophia: If we route to previous, be mindful cache warmup cost; we might see transient latency but 5xx should drop if it's kernel-related.

maya: Decision: hold rollout, keep canary pinned at 5%, no immediate rollback. Ops to gather traces + heap profiles. If 5xx exceeds 1.5% across the canary for 10m we'll auto-rollback. I'll add this to release notes.

sam: Adding checklist to the incident: 1) collect perf traces (`/ops/trace collect --ids 10,11`), 2) capture heap profiles, 3) run limited synthetic load against canary, 4) test quantize-v2 toggle on a subset.

jake: Started trace collection and attached logs to the incident. Also running a small bench (50rps) against the canary to reproduce.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this channel for deploy coordination. If anyone sees new spikes, post quick metrics + link. Will update release notes: "hold due to prefix-cache/429 spike; investigation ongoing". :thumbsup:
